nameOrigin: of great size/importance; lord or master

pokedexEntries.go: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

pokedexEntries.si: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

pokedexEntries.cr: Because this POKéMON’s skin is so tough, a normal attack won’t even leave a scratch on it.

pokedexEntries.ru: DONPHAN’s favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this POKéMON can’t stop very easily.

pokedexEntries.sa: If DONPHAN were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the POKéMON helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

pokedexEntries.fr: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

pokedexEntries.lg: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

pokedexEntries.em: A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won’t even leave a scratch.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

pokedexEntries.sc: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won’t faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

pokedexEntries.vi: Donphan is normally a calm Pokémon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.
